title: Herbal Irish Prawns Curry
description: A light, herbal onepot Irish curry that pairs raw frozen prawns with tandoorseared aromatics, halalfriendly ingredients, and a splash of coconut milk.
instructions: Preheat your tandoor (or grill pan) to 250 °C; rinse and pat dry the frozen prawns.
Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in a heavy‑bottomed pot over medium heat; add the diced onion and sauté until translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger, cooking for an additional minute until fragrant.
Stir in the tomato paste, curry powder, salt, pepper, and chili flakes; cook for 2 minutes to develop the flavors.
Pour in the coconut milk and bring the mixture to a gentle simmer, allowing it to thicken slightly, about 3 minutes.
Add the tandoor‑seared prawns to the pot and cook for 4–5 minutes, or until the prawns turn pink and opaque.
Finish the curry with a splash of lemon juice, a handful of fresh cilantro, and a sprinkle of mint; adjust seasoning if needed.
Serve hot, optionally over steamed rice or with a side of crusty Irish soda bread.
